summary: Modelli Visita feature tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite test_visit_templates.py (19 tests, all passing) covering library seeding (cardio 10 fields incl. Pressione arteriosa/parametri_vitali, pediatric 9 fields), CRUD (create w/o fields -> base, create custom, rename+reorder, rename-only keeps fields), 422 validation (empty name, empty titolo, invalid gruppo), 404 on unknown/foreign ids, tenant isolation cardio vs pediatra, 401 unauth, DELETE ok + 400 on last template (verified on medico@mantmed.it with 1 template), consultation start with template_id (template_name, sezioni prefilled with empty testo, status processing), async mapping exactly in template order (Pressione 135/85, Holter extracted), no template_id -> first template, invalid template_id -> fallback to first, pediatric run keeps TORL/allattamento/svezzamento, PDF section 04 Parametri for adult and pediatric vitals. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): settings card at /app/impostazioni?sezione=modelli - pills, Nuovo modello, rename, up/down reorder, delete field, add field with group/hint, save disabled with empty title, Salva toast, persistence after reload, Duplica '(copia)', Elimina (confirm) , Ripristina modello base toast; consultation overlay template picker (3 templates listed with field counts), choosing 'Controllo breve', manual transcript, free name + paper consent, shimmer on sezioni while processing, filled results: Pressione arteriosa in Parametri tab, Holter ECG in Esame tab. Pediatric regression in UI: TORL/Torace/Addome in Esame tab + template esame fields, Allattamento/Svezzamento in Anamnesi tab + template anamnesi fields, GrowthPanel + vitals sezioni in Crescita tab. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: Seeding is not atomic: two concurrent first calls (e.g. settings page + overlay, or two tabs) for a doctor with no templates can insert two 'Prima visita' docs. Consider a unique seed marker / upsert on {seed:true} or find_one_and_update with upsert.
No upper bound on number of fields / templates per doctor (very large lists will bloat LLM prompt). Consider a sane cap (e.g. 40 fields).
Unknown/invalid template_id silently falls back to first template instead of 400/404 (acceptable, but undocumented).

issues: Intro copy still says 'trasformata nella cartella pediatrica: ... crescita' for Cardiologia doctor - should be specialty-aware
Switching template pill or clicking Nuovo/Duplica silently discards unsaved draft edits (no dirty warning)
'Nuovo modello' immediately persists a server template named 'Nuovo modello'; pill label does not reflect the typed name until saved
Group select uses native <select> (acceptable, but inconsistent with shadcn components)
